import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    tile = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    
    # Create strided view for average pooling
    tile_view = tile.ap([[1, C], [p, H // p], [p, W // p], [1, p], [1, p]])
    
    # Compute average over the pool dimensions
    avg = nl.sum(tile_view, axis=[2, 4]) / (p * p)
    
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=out, src=avg)
    return out
